title: MS-GLA: Multi-Scale Gated Linear Attention for Addressing Representational Bottlenecks via Multi-Temporal Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2609.35664v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Gated Linear Attention (GLA) Transformers advance linear recurrent models through data-dependent gating, but face a core limitation: the fixed-capacity memory matrices across all heads operate at a single temporal resolution, where each token is processed individually, forcing them to simultaneously encode local syntactic patterns and long-range semantic structure, creating a representational bottleneck that gating alone is insufficient to resolve. We introduce Multi-Scale Gated Linear Attention (MS-GLA), which addresses this by distributing attention heads across multiple temporal resolutions. Coarser resolutions pool longer token spans naturally specializing toward long-range dependencies, while finer head groups retain sensitivity to local syntactic structure. A learnable, input-dependent fusion layer dynamically recombines head group outputs at each timestep, expanding effective memory capacity without increasing per-head s

translated_title: MS-GLA：通过多时间分辨率解决表示瓶颈的多尺度门控线性注意力
translated_abstract: 门控线性注意力（GLA）Transformer 通过数据依赖的门控机制推动了线性循环模型的发展，但面临一个核心局限：所有注意力头共享的固定容量记忆矩阵在单一时间分辨率下运行，每个词元被逐一单独处理，这迫使它们必须同时编码局部句法模式和长程语义结构，从而造成了仅靠门控机制无法解决的表示瓶颈。我们提出多尺度门控线性注意力（MS-GLA），通过将注意力头分布到多个时间分辨率上来解决这一问题。较粗分辨率的头组池化更长的词元跨度，自然地专门化于长程依赖关系；而较细的头组则保留对局部句法结构的敏感性。一个可学习的、依赖输入的融合层在每个时间步动态重组各头组的输出，从而在不增加每头状态大小的情况下扩展了有效记忆容量……
tldr: 提出多尺度门控线性注意力（MS-GLA），通过将注意力头分配到多个时间分辨率并用可学习的输入依赖融合层动态重组各头组输出，解决GLA Transformer在单一时间分辨率下的表示瓶颈，在不增加每头状态大小的情况下扩展有效记忆容量。
en_tdlr: MS-GLA resolves the representational bottleneck of Gated Linear Attention Transformers by distributing attention heads across multiple temporal resolutions and dynamically recombining their outputs through a learnable input-dependent fusion layer, expanding effective memory capacity without increasing per-head state size.
